package memberprofile // import "github.com/airencracken/comfylib/memberprofile"

const (
	MaxName  = 80
	MaxBio   = 1000
	MaxLinks = 5
	MaxLabel = 80
	MaxURL   = 2048
)

type Link struct {
	Label string `json:"label"`
	URL   string `json:"url"`
}

type Profile struct {
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Bio   string `json:"bio"`
	Links []Link `json:"links"`
}

func Normalize(p Profile) (Profile, error)

func ParseForm(values url.Values) (Profile, error)

func (p Profile) LinkFields() [MaxLinks]Link
